sum: Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation distributes and retails physical entertainment and collectible products for the entertainment industry internationally. It offers vinyl records, video games, digital video discs, Blu-ray, toys, compact discs, electronics, collectibles, and other entertainment and consumer products, as well as toys, figures, limited-edition collectibles, and licensed memorabilia. The company also provides third party logistics products and services. It distributes its physical media, entertainment products, hardware, and accessories through a multichannel strategy. The company exports its products. Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation was founded in 1990 and is based in Plantation, Florida.
